segments.title: A loading tab keeps its address, not about:blank
segments.body: A link with target=_blank to a page that answers after 8 s. About 1.5 s in, 0.2.45 turned the tab into about:blank: the row, the address field, and Copy URL (⇧⌘C, pasted into Notes). Now the row shows slow.example/timetable, the address field keeps slow.example and Copy URL copies the real address until the page arrives.
